requirements.name: Any INS page requires the user to be signed in, and returns them to the page they were headed to

scenarios.name: The address book list renders once signed in

tests.test: renders the address book after signing in

scenarios.name: Opening a page past the list unauthenticated requires signing in first

tests.test: lands on the sign in page when opening a page past the address book landing page
allows signing into a page past the address book landing page
tests.notes: after sign-in lands on /address-book/add, not the list

tests.test: redirectTo builds /auth/sign-in redirect including pathname and search
tests.notes: proves the return-URL redirect is constructed; does not exercise the browser sign-in round trip

tests.test: redirectTo encodes the return URL query string
tests.notes: encodes an address-book return path with query; still not the full unauthenticated round trip

requirements.name: The INS sign-in session lives alongside the animals and plants services' own, in one browser

scenarios.name: Signing in to animals, then INS, then plants keeps all three sessions

tests.test: signing in to animals, then ins, then plants in one browser keeps all three sessions
tests.notes: run green; reopens each dashboard without sign-in and asserts the three auth cookie names; not red-probed

requirements.name: A hidden sign-in through the real Defra ID shows what it returned, and leaves the service's own sign-in alone

scenarios.name: Without IDM configured, the IDM sign-in pages do not exist

tests.test: Should not serve %s
tests.notes: test.each over every IDM path; red-probed by serving the routes without a discovery URL

scenarios.name: The start page's button starts the sign-in at IDM

tests.test: Should show a start page whose Sign in with Defra ID button links to the route that goes to IDM
tests.notes: asserts the button's text and its target; red-probed by pointing the button elsewhere

tests.test: Should send the browser to the IDM authorize endpoint with the IDM client, service, policy and callback
tests.notes: against a mock IDM discovery document; red-probed by changing the policy. The real CP-Dev round trip is checked by hand

scenarios.name: A completed IDM sign-in shows the ID token claims, the access token claims and the token response

tests.test: Should list every ID token claim with its value and the token response, and say the access token is the ID token
tests.notes: compares every claim name and shown value with the signed token's payload; the ID token is verified against served keys. Red-probed by rendering a wrong claim value

tests.test: Should list every access token claim with its value when the access token is not the ID token
tests.notes: compares every claim name and shown value with the access token's payload; red-probed by rendering a wrong claim value

tests.test: Should exchange the code at IDM, show the token response IDM returned and measure the exchange as idm token-exchange
tests.notes: runs the callback through the IDM Bell strategy against a nocked IDM token endpoint; red-probed by mis-mapping expires_in

tests.test: Should resolve for a token issued to the IDM client when checked against IDM, and measure the key fetch as idm jwks
tests.notes: proves the IDM token check passes for its own client and issuer; not the page

scenarios.name: The IDM identity never reaches the rest of the service

tests.test: Should leave the caller's service session in the cache and set or clear no service session cookie
tests.notes: the callback carries a real sealed service session cookie for the cached session; red-probed by clearing the service session cookie in the callback

scenarios.name: An error from IDM shows a generic page with a link to try again

tests.test: Should show the unable to sign in page, linking back to the start page, and log the error in full, when IDM returns an error
tests.notes: red-probed by dropping the start-page link target and by dropping the IDM error fields from the log

tests.test: Should show the unable to sign in page, and log the refusal with the state and the IDM ids, when the ID token is signed by a key IDM does not serve
tests.notes: the unverifiable-token branch; not red-probed on its own

scenarios.name: The signed-in page with no IDM sign-in sends the user to the start page

tests.test: Should send a visitor with no IDM sign-in from the signed-in page to the start page

scenarios.name: The signed-out page needs no sign-in

tests.test: Should show the signed-out page without a session

scenarios.name: An error IDM sends to the signed-out page shows the generic page, not signed out

tests.test: Should show the unable to sign in page, not the signed-out page, and log the error in full, when IDM returns an error to the signed-out page
tests.notes: red-probed by rendering the signed-out page whatever the query

scenarios.name: No page of the service links to the IDM sign-in

tests.test: Should name no IDM sign-in page in any template or module of the service
tests.notes: reads every template and module under src/server/app for an IDM sign-in path; a link built elsewhere, or from config, would not be caught. Red-probed by adding a template that links to the start page
